verdict.rationale: Formant documents official SDKs: an Agent SDK for telemetry ingestion, commands and teleop, a Python Cloud SDK for querying and ingestion, and a RealtimeSDK and toolkit for building web apps. That gives it a real first-party SDK ecosystem. However, only Python is explicitly named as a language, nothing shows the SDKs are typed, and there is no evidence of Go or C++ SDKs or of coverage of the full platform surface (e.g. the Admin API). The OpenAPI probe also found no published spec. Missing for 10: confirmed TypeScript, Go and C++ SDKs, evidence of typed bindings, documented full-surface coverage including the Admin API, independent corroboration.
